title: Who the customer report is addressed to
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work orders - View'.
  2. A completed inspection whose work order has a company with full address details, a contact person, and fields attributed to users.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the Customer block shows the company on the work order with its name, address, city, state, postal code and phone.
2. Confirm the contact person appears on a separate Contact row.
3. Confirm any field attributed to a user shows that person's name.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Customer block shows the company on the work order, with its name, address, city, state, postal code and phone.
  • The contact person appears on a separate Contact row.
  • Any field attributed to a user shows that person's name.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9111 (S13 — Customer-facing inspection report); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S13; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R9: “The Customer block will show the company on the work order, with its name, address, city, state, postal code and phone”
  • S13-R10: “The contact person will appear on a separate Contact row”
  • S13-R11: “Any field attributed to a user will show that person's name”
